rules.condition: is this bot's hp below a quarter of its max?
rules.criteria_true: hp is less than 25% of max
rules.criteria_false: hp is 25% or more of max

rules.condition: is an enemy bearbot within melee range of an ally?
rules.criteria_true: an enemy is close to a low-hp ally
rules.criteria_false: no enemy is close to an ally

rules.condition: are multiple enemy bearbots bunched up near this bot?
rules.criteria_true: two or more enemies are clustered nearby
rules.criteria_false: only one or zero enemies are clustered

rules.condition: is an enemy bearbot within melee range?
rules.criteria_true: an enemy is close enough to touch
rules.criteria_false: no enemy is in melee range

rules.criteria_true: at least one enemy is visible
